flow.returnedRest: · observed, not a service-level commitment · audition, save, export, or chain a result as your next reference.

dims.title: What PYXIS-1 listens for
dims.lead: Four of the feature families PYXIS-1 measures, alongside harmony and tonal relationships, drawn from 70+ measurable audio characteristics. Deep per-track anatomy lives in Track Intelligence; here, they decide what belongs next.
dims.d1body: Percussion density, swing and accent placement — the rhythmic signature that determines whether two tracks can be mixed back-to-back, before you ever hear them together.
dims.d1steer: which results feel compatible in motion
dims.d2q: Where does it rise, hold or release?
dims.d2body: The journey of intensity across a track: builds, peaks, breakdowns and resets. Discovery visualises that journey, so you can make more confident decisions for your set or playlist.
dims.d2steer: how the energy of what comes next compares
dims.d3q: What gives it its sonic character?
dims.d3body: The colour and weight of the sound: brightness, density and texture, layered from sub to air. Timbre is why two tracks at the same tempo can feel worlds apart.
dims.d4q: How does it unfold over time?
dims.d4body: Intro, build, drop, break and outro: the phrase-level architecture that gives a track its shape. Track Intelligence reads it section by section.
dims.d4steer: how a track is built, section by section

aud.title: One engine. Different goals.
aud.djCopy: Start with one reference track and instantly discover a shortlist of compatible alternatives. Compare groove, energy and harmony before deciding what to play next.
aud.djA1: Groove and tempo alignment for mixing
aud.djA3: Key and harmony, read in Track Intelligence
aud.prodCopy: Explore tracks that circle the same musical idea: related textures, grooves and energy arcs. A reference board for direction, not a copying tool.
aud.supCopy: Answer a sonic brief with a detailed search: start from a known track, and build a shortlist that perfectly fits your needs.

proof.title: Based on real measurements.
proof.lead: Everything below is built around real product capabilities.
proof.s1: Every ranking starts from measured properties of the sound itself.
proof.s2: The profile is built from the whole recording, not a short excerpt.
proof.s3: The same reference returns the same shortlist from the same index.
proof.s4: Results ordered by similarity, ready to be analysed.
proof.s5: Every result carries its similarity score, and Track Intelligence explains the track behind it.
proof.s6: Unreleased references are processed for you only.
proof.v1: Every shortlist is assessed as an ordered answer, not a bag of hits.
proof.v2: Working professionals audition results against the reference.
proof.v3: Usefulness is measured at the result depths people actually use.
proof.v4: Every search is measured for both speed and the quality of its results.
proof.v5: The test that matters: do professionals return with the next reference?
proof.valFoot: sonic similarity is contextual, so validation asks "was this useful?", not "was this identical?"
proof.reserved: Approved beta feedback will appear here
